notice: Every fixture in this directory is a synthetic, hand-authored HTML snippet built to match the markup contract documented in src/vlr/parsers. None of them are captures of real VLR.gg pages. They exist solely to exercise parser logic deterministically without any network access.

team-page.html.purpose: Team page parser happy path: name, tag, country, logo, roster.

event-page-vct-americas.html.purpose: Event classified as an approved VCT region (Americas) via structured metadata.

event-page-masters.html.purpose: Event classified as Masters via parent series metadata.

event-page-champions.html.purpose: Event classified as Champions via parent series metadata.

event-page-excluded-tier2.html.purpose: Event excluded as tier-2 via an explicit tag.

event-page-excluded-game-changers.html.purpose: Event excluded as Game Changers via an explicit tag.

event-page-excluded-showmatch.html.purpose: Event excluded as a showmatch via an explicit tag.

event-page-unknown.html.purpose: Event with no classifiable evidence; must resolve to unknown, never an approved family.

event-discovery-page.html.purpose: Event discovery/listing page with a deliberate duplicate entry to test dedup.

match-list-page.html.purpose: Match list page for one event, with a deliberate duplicate match link to test dedup.

match-completed.html.purpose: Completed match with a full 3-map Bo3 result, including an overtime map.

match-completed-2.html.purpose: Second completed match (2-0), referenced by match-list-page.html's second entry, for end-to-end ingestion tests.

match-scheduled.html.purpose: Upcoming/scheduled match with no map results yet.

match-missing-fields.html.purpose: Completed match with several genuinely optional fields absent (series format, patch, attack/defense splits).

match-malformed.html.purpose: Malformed page missing the match header entirely, to prove the parser fails loudly instead of returning a silently empty record.

match-postponed.html.purpose: Postponed match with no map results, to exercise non-completed status handling.
